    Profile

    Yuan is an orphan from Wratharis, and Lucido's older brother. He's not talkative or sociable, but he has a lot of sympathy and kindness. He has strong moods of being unable to stay put, and when that happens, even in the middle of the night, he'll stir up some action.

    Origin: Wratharis
    Gender: Male
    Height: 182cm
    Weight: 68kg
    Birthday: Jun 14
    Blood Type: Type Ki
    Zodiac: Moon of the Dark Magic Dragon
    Likes: Bread
    Hobbies: Helping his younger brother
    Illust: 紺太
    CV: 宮崎寛務
